author: Nullz Bun
developer_reply: Thank you for your review! While I understand the desire for free access, maintaining a sustainable business model is crucial. The 3-item limit offers a fair opportunity to assess the app's functionality and effectiveness. This approach aids in making an informed decision before purchasing. Thank you for your understanding and (perhaps) support!

text: (Please write in English) Hi I recently use your application everyday. it's simple. I would like to find in it two more things. First, fill the cases with a number for exemple no more 3 coffees per day or five glasses of water .. and so on .. to follow the progress in the habits. Second, fill the cases with red green or orange, for me that color Orange means "in progress". Not red undone, not green done, But orange in progress. It will be great if you could add that two things Thanks you.
author: Emmanuelle Bacq
developer_reply: Hi there! Thanks for using our app and for the great suggestions – limiting items and adding a color-coded progress system sound like fantastic ideas. We'll definitely consider them for future updates. Your feedback is much appreciated!

text: I've purchased the premium, but the app never got updated to it. Nothing wrong with my phone, Google acc or anything. This kind of problem has never happened to me (or with anybody I asked). I've reached the app's support but so far only got "we'll fix it or refund" emails, but no actual fixing or refunding. I'd love to rate the app, but I never really got to use it. All I got was a bad day, a bad customer support and a record of first time having any problem with a Google Play purchase.
author: João Flávio Menezes Amaral
developer_reply: Dear João, I'm sorry to see this bad review. We are truly on this issue as I explained in our email exchange. As promised you will get a full refund if we can't fix the issue. But please allow a little bit more than 17 hours to get to the bottom of this non-trivial problem. I will keep you posted by email, but I must stand up for our product too!
